overall_summary: Family emotional themes (Maa, Papa, Bhai, general life motivation) vastly outperform niche toxic-romance digital-deletion loops, achieving up to 284 views compared to single-digit views on repetitive self-respect digital cleansing formats.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother (216 views), Father (135 views), Brother (98 views), and calling a loved one (284 views) significantly outperform romantic angst shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core emotional focus toward universal bonds and foundational life realities rather than exclusively toxic romance.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeatedly making shorts about deleting numbers, unpinning chats, or clearing storage (e.g., views ranging from 0 to 23) shows audience fatigue.
weak_patterns.action: Stop using repetitive digital interface cleanup hooks and diversify into deeper physical or emotional life observations.
